book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesu Iraḡaniꞌa Nufiro
Mada fuꞌo tiba fare ḡarugano Iesuꞌa Petero, Iakobo zu Iakobo negoḡa Ioane zamazadu zeḡe daꞌo maḡa boro itiro.
Eꞌea ani iraḡaniꞌa zeḡe ubumao nufiro. Iraḡaniꞌa mada teige agararo ebu dabuaḡaniꞌa agaḡa teige ꞌuraro.
Eꞌe madaḡano zeḡe zamao Mose zu Eliaꞌa fureranadu Iesu teite ḡoeriro.
Ebu Peteroꞌa Iesu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eme ꞌaha radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe manoḡa. Ḡa uratine e taruha uḡidu ogoraꞌuma. Tibaꞌe ḡae veize, tibaꞌe Mose veize ebu tibaꞌe Elia veize ogoraꞌuma.”
Aniꞌa ꞌize ḡoereꞌeteꞌea, ḡoze vazavazahoganiꞌa ovadu ze ogoziro. Ebu ḡozeonoꞌo ago ꞌahoganiꞌa ziro, “ꞌAhiꞌe eḡe zamarone Ubude. Ani uꞌano, e matuꞌe rudauꞌohe. Zaꞌe ani ḡoere egohanoꞌi.”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ago eꞌe igirotene, rihau rudanadu rahao ḡuḡuriro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa aradu oboziro ebu ziro, “Iḡunoꞌi. Ago rihanoꞌi.”
Zeḡeꞌa dude ehamarotene, vaze ꞌahoga mene horoniro, rehano Iesu daꞌo horoniro.
Ze maḡanonoꞌo ovairoteꞌea, Iesuꞌa riḡa ziro, “Zaeꞌa horonataꞌaꞌe vaze ꞌahoga ago noꞌi, onamo Vaze Ubuganiꞌa runeonoꞌo bare ḡabode iḡuniꞌuma.”
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ḡadiniro, “Nougadu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa, ꞌKerisoꞌa ꞌizema arogano Eliaꞌa ibite ariꞌuma,' rae raꞌohe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Hube hune Eliaꞌa aradu ḡau niduꞌa ruhibiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Elia ꞌai amahi ariro. Rehano vazeꞌa ani mene ederadu ani mazao zeḡeꞌa uratiroteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡairo. Eꞌe teige, Vaze Ubuga zuni zeḡe mazaonoꞌo aduga hidiꞌuma.”
ꞌOuge reirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Iesuꞌa Ioane Babatisoꞌe Elia rae reirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro.
Tahiꞌa Komeꞌa Vine Sauꞌaḡeta Manoniro
Iesu zu ane tahiꞌa uḡiduꞌa maḡanonoꞌo vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa vaḡe ovairotene, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu ane zamao obenaḡa hina tuḡiro ebu niro,
“Zuhiꞌa Boro, eḡe ubude vetuḡanoꞌi. Aniꞌe ketoketeꞌohe ebu ahiꞌaꞌe gigiꞌa boro maꞌohe. Aniꞌe ḡae ḡehaḡa ire rogao ga vuo higauꞌohe.
Eꞌa ani tutune ḡae tahiꞌatahiꞌa vaḡe areha, rehano zeꞌe ani manonoga mene idaraneha.”

Iesuꞌa eꞌea radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ziro, “Zaꞌe Badiꞌa mazao mene fiꞌeꞌeteꞌe zu veꞌoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa! E zae teite noꞌe faḡa radiꞌuma? E noꞌe faḡa zae mazao zamahe obone tiꞌuma? Tahiꞌa komeꞌa eꞌe eḡe vaḡe tutune aroꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa vine sauꞌa ronadu vine sauꞌaniꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa eꞌe mazaonoꞌo buaro. ꞌOugadu tahiꞌa komeꞌa eꞌeꞌa zogone manoriro.
Ebu ani tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa zeḡe daꞌo Iesu vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Emeꞌa nougadu vine sauꞌa hegone bunoga mene idaraneha?”

Aneꞌa naenaeziro, “Mazaḡa zaeꞌa fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe tahiḡa fase. Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zaꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe fufu maḡa komeꞌa tiba heuḡa radu maḡa ꞌahi mazao ninaꞌa, 'ꞌAdanoꞌo vaḡinadu ꞌomo onamoꞌi,' rae reine, maḡa eꞌeꞌa ꞌouge haḡaiꞌuma. Zaeꞌa eḡe mazao fine, ḡau niduꞌa haḡaogaꞌe idaḡa.”
Iesu Rune zu Bare Ḡaboditeꞌe moneo Ziro
Zeꞌa Galilea habaꞌano nuꞌorarotene, Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vaze Ubugaꞌe agireḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniꞌuma.
Zeꞌa ani maꞌuma ebu aniꞌa mada uḡiduḡano bare ḡabodiꞌuma.” ꞌOugadu Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe zamaze are rudaro.
Kuru Neḡa Takesiḡa
Zeꞌa Kaperanaumao feurirotene, kuru neḡa takesi azaḡaniꞌa Petero vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Zae ihore vazeḡaꞌe kuru neḡa takesi
mene hauꞌehe?”
Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “Mene, aniꞌe takesiḡa hauꞌohe.” Peteroꞌa ne diuḡirotene, Iesuꞌa ibite ḡadiniro, “Petero,
ḡa nouge rae zamareꞌohe? Haba kiniḡaꞌe iniu mazao takesi ufeꞌohe, ani haba azaḡa mazao ga avoꞌa azaḡa mazao?”
Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “Avoꞌa azaḡa mazao ufeꞌohe.” Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Oꞌe, ani haba azaḡaꞌe takesi mene hauꞌohe.
Rehano emeꞌa takesi azaḡa mene maḡunozinifine takesi ziniꞌuma. Ḡaꞌe duꞌura ovoadu kimai feunoꞌi. Ebu ibite manateꞌe ḡozoneḡa hebeꞌa mae nahanine, siliva hadiḡa tiba
horoniꞌuma. Eꞌe madu emenane veize zenoꞌi.”
